formation_structure.exposure_limit: Physician placement and earlier healing do not establish immunity to artillery. Confirmed patrol removal remains necessary.
formation_structure.final: Cardigan, Beagle, Melantha and Midnight hold four corridors. Hibiscus and Ansel heal their assigned formations. Lava covers both central lanes and Durin supports the lower lane.
formation_structure.healing_transition: Ansel enters at 109 seconds. After Steward leaves, Hibiscus enters at 116 seconds without removing Lancet-2. Noir Corne retains lower blocking under Ansel until Beagle's 134.5-second handoff.
formation_structure.opening: Plume and Noir Corne hold the central lanes. Fang holds the upper outer lane. Friston-3 catches the lower outer raider until Midnight replaces him. Lancet-2 supports the upper holders.
formation_structure.patrol_battery: Steward covers the eastern vertical circuit, GALLUS² its lower section and Durin its upper section. Actual attack allocation remains subject to current-model targeting; no forced patrol priority is assumed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity between 1 and 3 and qualification.normal_mode true. Exclude mode-specific reserves.
Every DEPLOY uses integer [row,col], a legal terrain tile and UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Execute the listed actions in order, including retreat before replacement at equal frames. A failed prerequisite invalidates this candidate; deterministic tooling must not change tactical actions.
Use initial 10 DP, modeled natural recovery and only Fang's two conditional +6 grants. Count no retreat refunds, Plume kill income or other unsupported income. Static minimum DP is 0.
At most eight operators are deployed. Required holders survive until their stated retreats; replacements preserve corridor coverage.
Battery operators must remain effective long enough to kill enemy_1112_emppnt#0 before frame 3420. Neither self-healing nor placement alone proves artillery survival.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Damage the designated roadblocks and intercept hostile officers; do not rely on civilian target priority or healing.
Confirm both restraint pairs are destroyed before restrained civilians suffer lethal officer or artillery pressure. Device HP, target order and exact destruction frames are not established.
Ansel's baseline range covers the lower trio; Hibiscus's covers the upper holder, Melantha and Lava. Cardigan receives ordinary physician healing without self-heal credit.
Claim WIN only with remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies. The last modeled spawn at frame 6330 is not itself completion.

Continue all final blocking, attacks and healing through residual armor and outer officers. Retain the formation after the listed skills until remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies are all confirmed.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Retain four purposeful opening interceptions and the eastern patrol battery, correct Midnight's preparation and recharge timing, then prioritize upper healing over an early defender upgrade. Hibiscus joins at 116 seconds while Ansel sustains Noir Corne until Beagle replaces him at 134.5 seconds. Lancet-2 remains until Lava's deployment. This fixed, untested candidate depends on battery survival, patrol removal before 114 seconds and timely civilian roadblock clearance.

current_model_rules.clock_and_sp: Actions use 30 FPS. Time-SP recovers at 1 SP/s while inactive and pauses during active skills.
current_model_rules.neutrality: Ordinary operators neither attack nor block Ursus Civilians.
current_model_rules.officers: Officers can attack civilians within radius 1.2.
current_model_rules.roadblocks: Active roadblocks specially restrain civilians within radius 0.4472 until destroyed.
current_model_rules.schedule: The diagnostic model's last spawn is at 211 seconds; its schedule is not an exact client fact.
